sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to fill in the wording of verse 9's 'shields of the earth belong to ___'. No earlier card has shown that line or the shields image, so the baker can only guess the next words. It is not a reasoned pick.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

sonnet.problem: The 'this is NOT a ...' punchline shape is repeated. Card 1 says 'it does NOT ease you in', card 3 says 'this is NOT polite little golf clapping', and card 12 says 'this is NOT a library'. That is the same punchline shape three times in one lesson.
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson.
